tabrion.comment: TABRION VER-1 (V-B0, K-34): the one tabrion of every installation, a final version (RC-8). Libraries (axentra, orkexa) require it only by a range that contains this version and pin this commit in requirements/tabrion.txt (RC-1, RC-7); nodestro-runtime (extras) and nodestro-api (dev) carry exactly this git pin (RC-2). pinned_by: the components that must carry the pin; PIN-W1 adds nodestro-runtime and nodestro-api once their pins are merged. A pin that is present is always checked, and once a pinned library requires tabrion every install that pulls it must carry the pin. releases: the authoritative release commit of each final (no tags yet); only these commits count as finals.

axentra.comment: Generic SaaS backend library, server profile only (the nodestro-runtime[postgres] extra); the studio never depends on it.

products.comment: Released products and the studio commit each one builds from (their studio.json); updated when a product's studio.json moves. `candidate` is a built and checked release candidate that is not published.
